ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Simulation can calculate performance, but technicians still decide how to assemble components, investigate abnormalities, and judge conditions on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 9,300 aerospace engineering and operations technologists and technicians employed in 2024, rising to a projected 10,100 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 800 jobs and about 900 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $79,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will shorten testing time. Simulation and automated data collection accelerate routine tests, shifting people from running data toward assembly and adjustment, troubleshooting, on-site judgment, and standards control. Standard data-collection-only roles face pressure, while people who assemble, tune, and troubleshoot become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Assembly from drawings: people provide hands-on skill.
Root-cause troubleshooting: people exercise judgment.
Field judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Standards oversight: people enforce the bottom line.
Operational coordination: people control the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate data collection and simulation, while people remain responsible for assembly, adjustment, and troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Standard data collection can be replaced, not engineering implementation. People who assemble, tune, and troubleshoot become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study electromechanical systems and drawing interpretation. Pure data collection is shrinking, so develop assembly, adjustment, and troubleshooting skills early.
Move beyond running tests toward assembly and adjustment plus troubleshooting and standards control. Work toward responsibility for major components.
Highlight projects and certifications. Research institutes value steadiness and attention to detail.
Do not evaluate candidates only on education. Look for the ability to implement drawings and troubleshoot. Core staff who can own components deserve strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation becomes widespread and data-collection work shrinks.
Assembly, adjustment, and troubleshooting receive greater emphasis.
People who implement drawings become more sought after.

body: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians install, test, and maintain aerospace components and systems from technical drawings. They run tests, collect data, and troubleshoot faults to ensure compliance with engineering standards.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Simulation can calculate performance, but technicians still decide how to assemble components, investigate abnormalities, and judge conditions on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 仿真能算，但件怎么装、异常怎么查、现场怎么判，还是技术员的手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年航空航天工程与运营技术员在岗约 0.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.01 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.98 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩试验时间。仿真与自动采集把常规测试提速，人从「跑数据」挪向「装调、排故、现场判断、标准把控」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准采集的，会装调、能排故的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 装调落图：手感靠人。
排故找因：判断靠人。
现场判断：取舍靠人。
标准把控：底线靠人。
协同衔接：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——采集与仿真被系统加速，但装调与排故还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准采集」动作，不是「工程落地」的岗位。会装调、能排故的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学机电与识图，纯采集在缩，早点练装调和排故。
从「跑试验」升级成「装调 + 排故 + 标准」，争取大部件负责。
突出项目与认证，院所看重稳和细。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会落图和排故，能扛件的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 仿真普及，采集缩。
装调排故更被看重。
会落图的人更抢手。

body: 航空航天工程与运营技术员按图纸安装、测试与维护航空航天部件与系统，运行试验、采集数据并排查故障，保障符合工程标准。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 仿真能算，但件怎么装、异常怎么查、现场怎么判，还是技术员的手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Color-mixing software can calculate formulas, but hairstylists still create the subtle look clients want and the sense of relaxation they feel in the chair.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 575,200 barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 607,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 32,200 jobs, with approximately 75,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $35,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace hairstylists, but it will support business operations. Online appointments, color recommendations, and virtual hairstyle try-ons improve salon efficiency, shifting hairstylists from pure craft toward craft, client relationships, and personal brands. People limited to basic washing and cutting without client retention face the most pressure, while stylists with aesthetic judgment and conversational skill become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Aesthetic judgment: people determine the right look.
Needs discovery: people understand what clients want.
Tactile skill: people cut and color hair.
Client relationships: people cultivate repeat business.
On-site adaptability: people handle unexpected outcomes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, places this career in a low AI-exposure service area. Haircutting and styling depend heavily on people, while systems manage appointments and assist with recommendations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Basic washing, cutting, and scheduling tasks face replacement, while aesthetic consultation roles do not. Stylists with craftsmanship and client-management skills benefit from salon digitization, while people limited to mechanical washing and cutting face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through vocational training and practice cutting, coloring, and communication. Basic washing and cutting are shrinking in the AI era, so develop aesthetic judgment and client relationships early.
Advance from washing and cutting to styling, client relationships, and a personal brand. Learn color theory and social media, then aim for salon manager or independent owner.
Emphasize examples of your craft and client-development experience, specifying the styles you have handled. Salons value consistency and conversation.
When hiring, look beyond cutting speed to aesthetic judgment and client relationships. Stylists who retain clients merit higher commission rates.

ai_s7_trends: Salons digitize appointments and memberships.
Self-service hair coloring diverts basic tasks.
Stylists with aesthetic judgment and strong client relationships are more sought after.

body: Hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists provide haircuts, shampooing, coloring, perming, styling, and basic skin care. They recommend services based on face shape, personal style, and trends, complete treatments in salons or shops, and build client relationships.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Color-mixing software can calculate formulas, but hairstylists still create the subtle look clients want and the sense of relaxation they feel in the chair.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 调色软件能算配方，但客人想剪的「那点感觉」、坐在椅子上的放松感，还是发型师亲手给的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年美发师、发型师与美容师在岗约 57.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 60.74 万人，净增约 3.22 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.58 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.52 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代美发师，但会辅助经营。线上预约、调色推荐、发型试戴把门店效率提速，美发师从「纯手艺」挪向「手艺 + 客情 + 个人品牌」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础洗剪、不会维护客源的人，有审美会聊天的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 审美判断：气质靠人定。
沟通需求：想要啥靠人聊。
手部手感：剪染靠人做。
客情维护：回头靠人经营。
现场应变：意外靠人处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的服务区——剪发造型高度依赖人工，系统只管预约和辅助推荐。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「基础洗剪与排班」动作，不是「审美沟通」的岗位。有手艺、会经营客源的人，反而随门店数字化更吃香。怕的是只会机械洗剪、不懂客情的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职业培训打底，在校多练剪染和沟通。AI 时代纯洗剪在缩，早点练审美和客情。
从「洗剪」升级成「造型 + 客情 + 个人品牌」，学调色和社媒，争取当店长或开店。
突出手艺案例和客源经验，写清跟过哪些风格。沙龙看重稳和会聊。
选人别只看剪得快，要看有没有审美和客情。能留客的发型师，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 门店数字化，预约与会员上系统。
自助染发分流基础环节。
有审美会客情的发型师更抢手。

body: 美发师、发型师与美容师为顾客提供剪发、洗发、染烫、造型及基础皮肤护理，结合脸型气质与流行趋势给出方案，在沙龙或店面完成服务并建立客情。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 调色软件能算配方，但客人想剪的「那点感觉」、坐在椅子上的放松感，还是发型师亲手给的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn summaries and variances into reports, but analysts still need data to persuade decision-makers about who should receive funding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 50,400 budget analysts were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 51,000 by 2034, a net gain of about 600 jobs, with approximately 3,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $87,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Budget analysts, but it will accelerate aggregation. Once AI handles data collection, reporting, and variance analysis, analysts shift from building spreadsheets to balancing resources, explaining policy logic, and coordinating departments. People who can translate strategy into money and persuade business leaders are genuinely scarce.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification of overspending and anomalies
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection and validation of budget data
Automated calculation and reporting of execution variances
ai_s3_list: Resource tradeoffs: decide who receives money and who does not.
Policy understanding: connect compliance and strategy.
Cross-functional coordination: persuade business leaders.
Feasibility judgment: determine whether a project is worthwhile.
Accountability: sign off and accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI-exposure tier for financial data work. AI accelerates collection, reporting, and variance analysis, while people retain responsibility for tradeoffs and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces preparing and calculating, not persuading and judging. Budget analysts who understand the business, analyze well, and coordinate effectively become scarcer. Entry-level roles limited to aggregation face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in finance and accounting and study data analysis. In the AI era, business understanding matters more than spreadsheet production alone.
Master budgeting systems and AI tools and learn the business. Progress from producing spreadsheets to managing resources, then move into financial analysis.
Emphasize the budgets you prepared and the overspending you controlled. Evidence of analysis and coordination carries the most weight.
Hire for logic and business judgment, not credentials alone. Analysts who can persuade business leaders deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Integration of finance and operations increases demand for budget analysis.
BI and automated reports spread, reducing aggregation roles.
Multidisciplinary budget analysts who understand the business and data become scarcer.

body: Budget analysts (Budget analysts) prepare organizational budgets, monitor execution, and analyze variances. They translate strategic goals into financial resource plans and coordinate departments' compliant allocation and use of funds.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn summaries and variances into reports, but analysts still need data to persuade decision-makers about who should receive funding.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把汇总和差异算成报表，但「这笔钱该给谁」，还得分析师用数据去劝。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年预算分析师职业诊断在岗约 5.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.10 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.31 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.79 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代预算分析师，但会加速汇总。数据归集、报表和差异分析交给 AI 后，分析师从「做表」挪向「做资源权衡、讲政策逻辑、协调部门」。真正稀缺的是能把战略翻译成钱、还能说服业务头的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助识别超支与异常
项目可行性的快速测算
ai_s2_auto: 预算数据的自动归集与校验
执行差异的自动计算与报表
ai_s3_list: 资源权衡：钱给谁不给谁。
政策理解：合规与战略。
跨部门协调：劝业务头。
可行性判断：项目值不值。
责任兜底：签字担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的财务数据区——归集、报表、差异都能被加速，但权衡和协调仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「做和算」，不是「劝和判」。会分析、懂业务、能协调的预算师更稀缺。怕的是只做汇总的初级岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财务会计打底，在校多学数据分析。AI 时代拼业务理解，别只当做表员。
把预算系统和 AI 工具用熟，补业务常识。从「做表」升级成「管资源」，转财务分析。
突出你编过什么预算、控过什么超支。有分析和协调成果优先。
招人看逻辑和业务感，不止看证书。能劝业务头的分析师值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 业财融合提升预算分析需求。
BI 与自动报表普及，汇总岗压缩。
会业务懂数据的复合预算师更稀缺。

body: 预算分析师（Budget analysts）负责组织的预算编制、执行监控与差异分析，把战略目标转化为财务资源方案，并协调各部门在合规框架内合理分配与使用资金。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把汇总和差异算成报表，但「这笔钱该给谁」，还得分析师用数据去劝。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can handle scheduling and dispatch, but the driver's hands still determine how to brake when someone suddenly steps into the road.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 158,800 transit and intercity bus drivers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 165,600 by 2034, a net gain of about 6,800 jobs, with approximately 20,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $57,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Bus Drivers, Transit And Intercity, but it will change operations. As systems take over intelligent dispatch, driver assistance, and alerts, drivers shift from pure driving toward safety response, passenger service, and emergency handling. People who can navigate complex traffic, deliver passengers safely, and respond appropriately are genuinely scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time detour recommendations based on traffic
Intelligent predictions of arrivals and passenger loads
Coordinated assisted braking and obstacle avoidance
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent optimization of schedules and dispatch
Automated reminders for routine vehicle inspections
Automated verification of fares and discounts
ai_s3_list: On-road driving: machines struggle to replace road awareness and physical feel.
Emergency response: people brake when pedestrians or vehicles intrude.
Passenger service: people care for older adults and children.
Complex judgment: people decide when to merge or yield.
Safety accountability: people remain responsible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means core driving remains human while dispatch and assistance become digital.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still requires adaptation. Automation replaces dispatch and alerts, not driving. Drivers who provide service, handle incidents, and protect safety remain in demand. People who only operate pedals and ignore new assistance tools face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Earn an A-class license and passenger-transport qualification and practice safety and service during training. In the AI era, emergency handling and passenger care matter beyond driving technique.
Progress from driving toward safety plus service. Learn driver-assistance systems and emergency response, then pursue route-lead or dispatch roles instead of remaining in pure driving.
Emphasize your safety record and route experience, including complex routes you have driven. Valid qualifications and an accident-free record receive priority.
Hire for safety and temperament, not driving skill alone. Drivers who provide steady service and handle incidents well deserve safety bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent dispatch and driver assistance become routine.
Autonomous-driving pilots expand in campuses and on fixed routes.
Drivers who provide service and handle incidents become scarcer.

body: Bus Drivers, Transit And Intercity operate buses on established routes and schedules. They follow traffic and safety rules, transport passengers, protect boarding and exiting, inspect vehicles, announce stops, handle fares, and respond to incidents.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can handle scheduling and dispatch, but the driver's hands still determine how to brake when someone suddenly steps into the road.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排班和调度能交给系统，但「前面突然窜出个人怎么刹」，还得司机这双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公交与城际巴士司机在岗约 15.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.56 万人，净增约 0.68 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代公交驾驶员，但会改变运营。智能调度、辅助驾驶和预警交给系统后，驾驶员从「纯驾驶」挪向「安全处置、乘客服务与突发应对」。真正稀缺的是能在复杂路况里把人平安送到、处置得妥当的人。
ai_s2_accel: 到站与负载的智能预测
ai_s2_auto: 排班与调度的智能优化
票务与优惠的自动核验
ai_s3_list: 现场驾驶：路况与手感机器难替。
突发处置：人车闯入靠人刹。
乘客服务：老人小孩靠人顾。
复杂判断：并线让行靠人定。
安全兜底：责任要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——核心驾驶靠人，只有调度与辅助被数字化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也别躺平：被替代的是「调度和预警」，不是「驾驶」。会服务、能处置、守安全的驾驶员永远缺。怕的是只踩油门、不学新辅助的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 去拿 A 类驾照和客运资格，在校把安全和服务练了。AI 时代拼的是处置和服务，别只练驾驶。
从「开车」升级成「安全 + 服务」，学辅助驾驶和突发处置，争取转线长或调度，别停留在纯驾驶。
突出安全记录和线路经验，写清跑过哪些复杂线。有资格和无事故优先。
招人看安全和脾气，不止看车技。能稳服务、善处置的驾驶员值得给安全奖。

ai_s7_trends: 智能调度与辅助驾驶进日常。
园区与固定线试水自动驾驶。
会服务能处置的驾驶员更稀缺。

body: 公交与城际巴士司机是公交驾驶员按既定线路与时刻表驾驶公共汽车，遵守交通法规与安全规程，运载乘客并保障上下车安全，完成车辆例检、报站、票务与突发情况处置。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 排班和调度能交给系统，但「前面突然窜出个人怎么刹」，还得司机这双手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Health systems can send reminders at scale, but Community health workers build the trust needed to learn who lacks support and whose advice residents will follow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 65,100 Community health workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 72,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 7,400 jobs, with about 7,800 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $51,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Community health workers, but it will accelerate education and reminders. Health messages, follow-up systems, and record tools speed up repetitive work. Workers shift from distributing materials to building trust, visiting homes, referring resources, and organizing participation. Pure broadcast and form-filling roles face pressure, while people who understand local needs and make effective referrals become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Trust building: people earn credibility over time.
Home visits: people gain access to households.
Resource referrals: people explain where to go.
Community mobilization: people bring residents together.
Local-needs judgment: people identify who truly needs assistance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure tier. Systems accelerate health education and reminders, while trust building and follow-up still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure can coexist with stable demand. Automation replaces bulk messages and form filling, not trust-based referral work. Workers who understand local needs and can navigate resources become scarcer as tools improve. People who only distribute materials face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in medicine or public health and gain community experience during training. Pure health-education work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop trust-building and referral skills early.
Move beyond distributing materials by managing follow-ups and connecting resources. Learn health-record systems and work toward responsibility for a service area.
Highlight community and communication experience and specify which populations you served. Frontline employers value reliability and genuine commitment.
Do not assess candidates only by certificates. Evaluate whether residents trust them. Health workers who complete referrals and close service gaps merit stable positions.

ai_s7_trends: Population aging is increasing frontline demand.
Systems handle education messages while people conduct follow-ups.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能实时扫描每一笔投注和筹码动向，但牌桌上的气氛、玩家的情绪和那句恰到好处的「祝你好运」，还得发牌员本人来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年博彩发牌员在岗约 8.87 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.81 万人，岗位净减约 0.06 万个，年均产生约 1.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代博彩发牌员，但会接管结算和监控：自动洗牌机、电子牌桌、AI 防欺诈监控已经在普及，发牌员从「手动结算」转向「操作设备 + 维持桌面体验」。纯发牌动作会减少，但「人坐在桌边」这件事，赌场短期内离不开——玩家来赌场，要的就有这份现场感。
ai_s2_accel: AI 反欺诈模型实时标记可疑行为
线上与实体结合的娱乐场运营模式
智能筹码与 RFID 芯片追踪筹码流向
玩家忠诚度系统个性化服务
ai_s2_auto: 自动洗牌机接管洗牌环节
电子牌桌自动结算投注与赔率
AI 监控系统自动识别异常投注行为
筹码清点与账目核对的系统化
ai_s3_list: 现场节奏：让牌局又顺又有气氛，是门手艺。
异常识别：赌桌上「不对劲」的第六感。
情绪管理：输家赢家都要安抚到位。
合规执行：规程背后是赌场的生存底线。
临场应变：起争议时稳住局面不砸场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这行的「规则性操作」正被系统深度替代——结算、洗牌、监控都能自动化；但「人在桌边」的现场价值、互动和合规氛围，是赌场运营的核心资产，评分高的是动作，不是岗位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于末路：会操作电子牌桌、读懂 AI 监控提示的发牌员，能更快升到主管和监控岗。真正被替代的是「只会手洗牌、手动算」的老操作——赌场巴不得把这些换成机器。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 赌场发牌不是常规职业路径，且中国大陆不合法。如果孩子考虑海外赌场就业，先想清楚夜班、烟酒环境和行业合规边界，别把「轻松高小费」想得太美。
把电子牌桌、AI 监控和合规流程学熟，往荷官主管、监台、防欺诈岗位走。别只当「发牌的手」，要往懂运营、懂风控的方向升级。
想入行只能去合法博彩区域，从发牌学校培训起步。零售收银、服务业背景的适应更快；简历上突出心算、节奏和合规意识。
招发牌员别只看手法，要看情绪管理和合规意识；给夜班和节假日补贴，提供晋升监台和监控岗的通道，能留得住人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 洗牌自动化，防人为误差
异常投注行为实时标记
个性化服务与积分管理
黑名单识别与入场管理

ai_s7_trends: 电子牌桌与自动洗牌全面普及，纯手工发牌环节持续减少。
AI 风控与合规监控成为赌场标配，运营岗需求上升。
合法博彩区域扩张与线上化并行，发牌员向运营与监管复合岗转型。

body: 博彩发牌员在合法赌场中主持牌局，负责洗牌发牌、报点、计算赔率、收付筹码与维护桌面秩序，同时观察桌面异常、执行赌场合规规程，是赌场一线运营的核心岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能实时扫描每一笔投注和筹码动向，但牌桌上的气氛、玩家的情绪和那句恰到好处的「祝你好运」，还得发牌员本人来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Cloud platforms can generate maps automatically, but GIS Technologists and Technicians still decide which models are worth building, how to turn spatial patterns into business conclusions, and how to verify conditions in the field.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 472,000 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 510,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 38,500 jobs, with roughly 31,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $109,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace GIS Technologists and Technicians, but it will reduce entry-level work. Automated mapping and cloud GIS accelerate routine cartography, shifting technicians toward model design, spatial interpretation, cross-source validation, and business support. People limited to standard map production face displacement, while those who can model and interpret data become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Model design: people define the problem.
Spatial interpretation: people explain the conclusion.
Field verification: people safeguard accuracy.
Cross-source integration: people decide tradeoffs.
Business support: people determine how results are used.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Systems accelerate basic cartography, while people retain responsibility for modeling and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces standard map production tasks, not spatial decision-support roles. People with modeling and interpretation skills become scarcer as productivity rises. Technicians limited to standard maps face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Develop both geography and programming skills. Pure map production is shrinking in the AI era, so learn modeling early.
Progress from drawing maps to building models and explaining conclusions, and study remote sensing and data science.
Emphasize database and modeling projects, and clearly identify the platforms you have used.
Do not evaluate candidates only by software proficiency; assess how they think about models. Strong contributors who support decisions merit higher project compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated mapping is becoming widespread, reducing basic roles.
Remote sensing and modeling create opportunities.
Technicians with interpretive ability are in greater demand.

body: GIS technologists and technicians collect, process, and manage spatial data, build geographic databases, run spatial analyses, and create thematic maps to support planning, environmental, and asset decisions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Cloud platforms can generate maps automatically, but GIS Technologists and Technicians still decide which models are worth building, how to turn spatial patterns into business conclusions, and how to verify conditions in the field.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 云端能自动出图，但哪类模型值得建、怎么把空间讲成业务结论、现场怎么核，还是技术员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信息系统技术专家技术员在岗约 47.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.05 万人，净增约 3.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 GIS 技术员，但会压缩基础岗。自动化出图与云端 GIS 把常规制图提速，技术员从「画地图」挪向「模型设计、空间解读、跨源核查与业务支撑」。真正被挤掉的是只会出标准图的，有建模力能解读的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 模型设计：问题靠人定。
空间解读：结论靠人讲。
现场核查：精度靠人。
跨源整合：取舍靠人。
业务支撑：用法靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的地理区——基础制图被系统加速，但建模与解读还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「出标准图」动作，不是「空间决策支撑」的岗位。有建模力、能解读的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会画标准图的技术员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 地理 + 编程都要练，AI 时代纯出图在缩，早学建模。
从「画地图」升级成「建模型 + 讲结论」，学遥感与数据科学。
突出建库与建模项目，写清用过的平台。
选人别只看软件，看建模脑子。能支撑决策的骨干值得给高项目费。

ai_s7_trends: 自动出图普及，基础岗缩。
遥感与建模带来机会。
有解读力的技术员更抢手。

body: GIS 技术专家与技术员采集、处理与管理空间数据，搭建地理数据库，运行空间分析并制作专题地图，支撑规划、环境与资产决策。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 云端能自动出图，但哪类模型值得建、怎么把空间讲成业务结论、现场怎么核，还是技术员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Simulation can calculate structures, but engineers still decide which devices are worth building, how to define the process window, and who takes responsibility across processes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 158,800 nanosystems engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 162,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,300 jobs, with roughly 9,300 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $117,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nanosystems engineers, but it will reduce standard production roles. Simulation and automated characterization accelerate routine fabrication planning, shifting engineers from running processes toward device design, cross-process tradeoffs, and data-driven optimization. People limited to standard fabrication execution will lose ground, while those who can design and use data will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Device design: people provide the creativity.
Process tradeoffs: people make the choices.
Cross-process coordination: people carry the responsibility.
Exception decisions require human judgment.
Scaling to mass production: people provide the experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure area of nanoengineering. Systems accelerate standard fabrication, while people remain essential for device design and process tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Standard fabrication execution is being replaced, not roles that coordinate device design. Engineers with modeling and design skills become even scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build modeling and simulation skills from the start of your science education. Pure fabrication work is shrinking, so develop design skills early.
Progress from running equipment to device design + data optimization, and learn simulation.
Emphasize device and yield cases and clearly state your domain.
Do not hire based only on equipment experience. Assess whether candidates can design and work from data.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation becomes widespread, reducing standard roles.
Device design and data optimization command premiums.
Multidisciplinary engineers are in greater demand.

body: Nanosystems engineers lead the design and supervise the fabrication of nanoscale materials and devices, coordinating structures, processes, and characterization while using simulation and experiments to improve performance and manufacturability.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Simulation can calculate structures, but engineers still decide which devices are worth building, how to define the process window, and who takes responsibility across processes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 仿真能算结构，但哪个器件值得做、工艺窗口怎么定、跨工艺的锅谁背，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年纳米系统工程师在岗约 15.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.21 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.93 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.78 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代纳米系统工程师，但会压缩标准岗。仿真与自动表征把常规制备编排提速，工程师从「跑工艺」挪向「器件设计、跨工艺权衡、数据驱动优化」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准制备执行的人，能设计与用数据的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 器件设计：创意靠人。
工艺权衡：取舍靠人。
跨工艺协调：责任靠人。
异常决策：判断靠人。
量产推进：经验靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的纳米工程区——标准制备被系统加速，但器件设计与工艺权衡还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑标准制备」动作，不是「统筹器件设计」的岗位。有建模力、能设计的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 理科起步多练建模和仿真，纯制备在缩，早点练设计。
从「跑设备」升级成「器件设计 + 数据优化」，学仿真。
突出器件与良率案例，写清领域。
选人别只看设备，看能不能设计和数据驱动。

ai_s7_trends: 仿真普及，标准岗缩。
器件设计与数据优化溢价。
复合工程师更抢手。

body: Nanosystems Engineers 主导纳米尺度材料与器件的设计与制备监督，统筹结构、工艺与表征，运用仿真与实验提升性能与可制造性。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 仿真能算结构，但哪个器件值得做、工艺窗口怎么定、跨工艺的锅谁背，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can perform automated refraction, read fundus images, and predict myopia risk, but an optometrist must still determine in person what lies behind a patient's comment that lights cause glare while driving at night and how to adjust a pair of glasses.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 47,800 optometrists were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 51,600, a net increase of about 3,800 jobs, with about 2,400 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $134,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace optometrists, but it will replace tasks limited to measuring prescriptions. Autorefractors, AI fundus screening, and visual-function data analysis are becoming increasingly accurate. Optometrists' value is shifting toward integrated judgment, patient communication, and eye-health management. Combining machine results with a person's circumstances to reach a conclusion is precisely what AI cannot do.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted prediction of myopia progression in children
Corneal topography and smart contact lens fitting
Remote ophthalmology consultations and referral coordination
Virtual try-on and outcome simulation for glasses
ai_s2_auto: Automated refraction and computerized generation of refraction data
AI screening of fundus images for common eye diseases
Digital optometric files and examination records
Digital fitting workflows and appointment management
ai_s3_list: Integrated judgment: analyzing refraction data + symptoms + visual habits.
Patient communication: explaining professional terms in language patients understand.
Eye disease recognition: spotting signs during examinations that require referral.
Complex refractive care: plans for strabismus, amblyopia, and mixed astigmatism.
Communicating with children: helping active young patients cooperate with examinations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates substantial automation in data acquisition. Automated refraction and AI screening are mature, but optometrists' core value lies in data-based integrated judgment and interpersonal service. AI cannot replace this work, and patients place greater trust in examinations performed by people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium risk does not mean no change. Refractionists who only print autorefractor results face the greatest risk because AI can already do that work. The field most needs people who move into optometric care, myopia prevention, and eye-health management while using AI as an assistive tool.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Optometry programs offer clear career paths and a meaningful talent shortage, making them suitable for meticulous and patient students. Those aiming for hospitals and premium optical stores should plan their education and credentials early instead of focusing only on optical-store jobs.

Master clinical refraction and visual-function testing, and earn higher-level optometry credentials. Specialize in childhood myopia prevention, presbyopia management, or optometric care. Use AI tools, leave routine refraction to machines, and focus your energy on comprehensive services.

People with medical backgrounds such as nursing or pharmacy can transition into optometry relatively smoothly. Start by earning a refractionist credential and working in a store, then move toward a hospital optometry center. Emphasize attention to detail and service orientation in interviews, since stores highly value approachability.

Do not reduce optometrists to printout clerks. Their value comes from having time for examinations and communication. Teams that provide AI screening equipment and integrate optometric services with eyewear fitting are better able to retain excellent optometrists.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid generation of reference refractive data
Automatic detection of abnormalities in fundus images
Corneal shape assessment and contact lens fitting
Virtual try-on of frames and visual effects

ai_s7_trends: As automated refraction and AI screening spread, routine prescription measurement is being replaced.
Childhood myopia prevention and presbyopia management are becoming the optometry industry's main growth areas.
Optometrists are shifting from eyewear fitting services to professional eye-health management roles.

body: Optometrists are eye-care professionals with systematic training in optometry. They perform vision examinations and clinical refraction, prescribe glasses and contact lenses, assess visual function, screen for common eye diseases, and provide guidance on myopia prevention and eye-health management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can perform automated refraction, read fundus images, and predict myopia risk, but an optometrist must still determine in person what lies behind a patient's comment that lights cause glare while driving at night and how to adjust a pair of glasses.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动验光、读眼底片、预判近视风险，但患者那句「我晚上开车看灯会眩光」背后的原因，和一副眼镜该怎么调，还得验光师当面判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年验光师在岗约 4.78 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.16 万人，净增约 0.38 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代验光师，但会替代「纯验度数」的环节：自动验光仪、AI 眼底筛查、视功能数据分析越来越准。验光师的价值转向综合判断、患者沟通和眼健康管理——把机器结果和人的情况放在一起下结论，正是 AI 做不了的事。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助儿童近视进展预测
角膜地形图与接触镜智能验配
远程眼科会诊与转诊协作
智能眼镜试戴与效果模拟
ai_s2_auto: 自动验光与电脑验光数据生成
AI 眼底图像筛查常见眼病
视光档案与检查记录电子化
验配流程与预约管理数字化
ai_s3_list: 综合判断：验光数据+症状+用眼习惯的综合分析。
患者沟通：把专业术语讲成患者听得懂的话。
眼病识别：在检查中发现需要转诊的信号。
复杂屈光处理：斜视、弱视、混合散光的方案。
儿童沟通：让好动的小朋友配合检查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的「数据获取」环节自动化程度不低：自动验光、AI 筛查都很成熟，但验光师的核心价值在「基于数据的综合判断和人际服务」，这部分 AI 替代不了，患者也更信任人的检查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：只会「电脑验光仪打单子」的验光员风险最大，因为那部分工作 AI 已经能做。往视光诊疗、近视防控、眼健康管理走，把 AI 当辅助工具，反而是行业最缺的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 眼视光学专业就业方向清晰、缺口不小，适合细心有耐心的孩子。提醒：想进医院和高端门店，学历和资格证都要提前规划，别只盯着眼镜店打工。
把医学验光和视功能检查学透，考更高级别的视光资格。往儿童近视防控、老视管理、视光诊疗方向深耕，AI 工具用起来，把纯验光的活交给机器，把精力放在综合服务上。
护理、药学等医学背景的人转视光比较顺。先考验光员资格从门店做起，再往医院视光中心走；面试时强调你的细致和服务意识，门店很看重亲和力。
别让验光师变成「打单员」，给时间做检查和沟通才是价值所在。配好 AI 筛查设备、做视光与配镜一体化的团队，优质验光师才留得住。

快速生成屈光参考数据
眼底图像自动识别异常
角膜形态与隐形眼镜验配

ai_s7_trends: 自动验光与 AI 筛查普及，纯验度数环节被替代。
儿童近视防控与老视管理成为视光行业核心增量。

body: 验光师是接受眼视光学系统训练的眼保健专业人员，负责视力检查与医学验光、开具眼镜与隐形眼镜处方、评估视功能、筛查常见眼部疾病，并提供近视防控与眼健康管理建议。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动验光、读眼底片、预判近视风险，但患者那句「我晚上开车看灯会眩光」背后的原因，和一副眼镜该怎么调，还得验光师当面判断。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 34,900 operators were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to decline to 34,000, a net loss of about 900 jobs, with about 3,200 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $97,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and intelligent systems will not immediately replace refinery and petroleum pump-station operators, but they will change how facilities are staffed. Intelligent centralized control, AI alerts, and remote inspection take over monitoring and meter reading, shifting operators from watching parameters toward equipment judgment, startups and shutdowns, and emergency response. The judgment and accountability involved in startups, shutdowns, and emergencies cannot be replaced by machines, making process-savvy operators more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Pilot use of intelligent inspection robots
ai_s2_auto: Automated anomaly alarms and early warnings
Remote valve, pump, and machinery control
ai_s3_list: Experienced process-unit judgment: recognize anomalies immediately through sound, smell, and vibration.
Startup and shutdown operations: every step must be correct, relying on procedures and tactile experience.
Decisive emergency response: during leaks and overpressure, protect safety before equipment.
Deep process understanding: know why each parameter is adjusted.
Safety and environmental responsibility: incidents at energy facilities are major events.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that roughly half of monitoring and watchkeeping is becoming digital. DCS and AI support parameter monitoring, data records, and alarms.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over meter watching and data recording, leaving equipment judgment and emergency response. Pure watchkeeping roles will decline, while technicians who understand processes and perform startups and shutdowns become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study petrochemical engineering, oil and gas storage and transportation, or automation, and obtain special-operation certificates for hazardous chemicals and related work. Prepare for shifts and field conditions.

Learn intelligent centralized control, AI warning, and digital-twin systems, and actively participate in startups and shutdowns. Advance from operator to lead operator or process-unit technician and earn relevant qualifications.

A chemical or electromechanical background is ideal, with entry possible through operations apprenticeships. On a resume, specify which units you know, which anomalies you handled, and which certificates you hold.
When hiring operators, assess process understanding and emergency response, not shift availability alone. Young workers willing to learn intelligent systems deserve development into core unit staff.

ai_s7_trends: As intelligent centralized control and AI warnings spread, operators shift from watching meters and recording numbers toward equipment judgment, startups and shutdowns, and emergency response. Process understanding becomes the core competitive advantage.
Integrated refining and petrochemical development and pipeline-network expansion sustain demand for operators and technicians who understand processes and handle emergencies.
Smart inspection and digital twins are being implemented, shifting operators toward combined process + digital operations and maintenance roles.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能预警参数异常、远程能操控阀门，但「这声音不对是泵的问题还是管线的问题」「要不要切机」——装置区里的判断，还得靠老师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员在岗约 3.49 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.40 万人，岗位净减约 0.09 万个，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和智能化不会立刻取代炼油与油气泵站操作工，但会改变值守方式。智能集控、AI 预警、远程巡检正在接走监控抄表环节，操作工从「盯参数」转向「装置判断、开停工、应急处理」。装置开停工的判断和应急责任，是机器替代不了的核心——懂工艺的操作工反而更吃香。
ai_s3_list: 装置判断的经验：声音、气味、振动，异常一眼看出。
开停工的操作：装置启停一步都不能错，靠方案也靠手感。
应急处理的果断：泄漏、超压，先保安全再保装置。
工艺原理的吃透：为什么调这个参数，心里有数。
安全环保的责任：能源装置出事，就是大事。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业约有一半监控值守环节正在被数字化——参数监控、数据记录、报警，DCS 和 AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「盯表抄数」环节，留下的是「装置判断和应急」环节。纯值守岗会减少，懂工艺、会开停工的技师反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选石油化工、油气储运或自动化专业，考危化品等特种作业证。倒班和现场环境要有心理准备。
把智能集控、AI 预警和数字孪生系统学起来，主动参与开停工。从「操作工」升级为「主操、装置技师」，考取相关资格。
有化工或机电背景最好，可从运行操作学徒切入。简历上多写「会哪些装置、处理过什么异常、有没有证」。
招操作工别只看能倒班，要看工艺理解与应急处置。愿意学智能系统的年轻人，值得培养成装置骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 智能集控与 AI 预警普及，操作工从「盯表抄数」转向「装置判断、开停工、应急处理」，工艺理解成为核心竞争力。
炼化一体化与管网建设扩张，懂工艺、能应急的操作工与技师需求稳定。
智能巡检与数字孪生落地，操作工向「工艺+数字化运维」复合角色转变。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI and warehouse robots already handle scan-record-putaway workflows, leaving people to resolve system errors and investigate inventory shortages.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 862,200 shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 795,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 66,400 jobs, with about 69,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $43,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: Shipping, receiving, and inventory clerks face direct AI disruption. Barcode scanning, RFID, automated sorting, and WMS have replaced many standard inventory movements, reducing pure operating roles. Warehouses still need people for exceptions such as damage disputes, inventory discrepancies, rush orders, and on-site coordination with drivers and customers.
ai_s2_accel: AI replenishment forecasting and location optimization
Visual inspection and automatic damage detection
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: on-site judgment of damage, mix-ups, and missing items.
Inventory discrepancy analysis: finding causes when records and stock differ.
Multi-party coordination: connecting drivers, suppliers, sales, and logistics.
Emergency response: rush orders, shortages, and system outages.
Process improvement: finding smoother methods in repetitive work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score shows that receiving, shipping, inventory, and document data are highly automatable. But 6 is not 8: exception handling and interpersonal coordination remain human work, and risk depends on moving toward operations or management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: The best response is to advance: master WMS, understand inventory data, and lead small teams. Then you become an administrator who sets system rules rather than an operator replaced by them.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People with limited education can enter supply chains through warehouse clerk roles, but should learn WMS and data analysis while working. Pure operations are a stepping stone, not a destination.
Learn system administration, planning, and warehouse supervision. Upgrade from scanning to reading inventory reports, investigating discrepancies, and improving processes.

The field welcomes newcomers, but interviews should emphasize carefulness and data handling. Forklift credentials and WMS knowledge help, and automated facilities offer stronger learning opportunities.
Do not recruit warehouse staff as pure labor. Provide system training and advancement paths; retaining people who understand systems and handle exceptions costs less than repeatedly hiring operators.

ai_s7_trends: Warehouse automation continues increasing and pure operating jobs continue shrinking.
WMS and data analysis are becoming firm requirements for advancement.
E-commerce and instant retail are rapidly increasing multi-category, small-batch fulfillment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 和仓储机器人已经在「扫码-录单-上架」这条流水线上跑起来了，留给人的是「系统报错怎么办、盘点差货怎么查」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年发运、收货、库存文员在岗约 86.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 79.58 万人，岗位净减约 6.64 万个，年均产生约 6.93 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.32 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 发运、收货、库存文员是 AI 冲击最直接的岗位之一：条码扫描、RFID、自动分拣和 WMS 已经替代了大量收发存的标准动作，纯操作岗数量在收缩。但仓库永远需要人处理异常——货损纠纷、盘点差异、临时插单、司机和客户的现场协调，这些「系统外的活」短期离不开人。
ai_s2_accel: AGV 机器人自动搬运与上下架
AI 预测补货与库位优化
视觉验货与破损自动识别
运输轨迹的自动跟踪推送
ai_s2_auto: 库存数据自动对账与预警
ai_s3_list: 异常处理：货损、串货、缺件的现场判断。
盘点差异分析：账实不符时能查出原因。
多方协调：司机、供应商、销售、物流的衔接。
应急应变：插单、缺货、系统宕机的处理。
流程优化：从重复劳动里找出更顺的做法。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个岗位的数据面高度自动化：收发货、库存、单据全是结构化数据，正是 AI 和机器人的主场；但 6 分也意味着还没到 8 分——异常处理和人际协调仍是人力活，关键看你往操作端还是管理端走。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 对这类岗位，最该做的不是焦虑，而是往上爬：学透 WMS、看懂库存数据、会带小团队，你就从「会被系统替代的操作员」变成了「给系统定规则的管理员」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历不高又想进供应链，可以先从仓管文员入行，但一定要边干边学 WMS 和数据分析，给自己留转岗空间；纯操作岗不是终点，只是跳板。
主动去学系统管理员、计划员、仓储主管的业务，把「会扫码」升级成「会看库存报表、会查差异、会优化流程」，这是躲开自动化的关键。
这行对新人友好，但面试要突出细心和数据处理能力；有叉车证、懂 WMS 的候选人明显更吃香，优先选有自动化系统的企业去学东西。
别把仓管当纯体力岗招：给系统培训和晋升通道，把懂系统、能处理异常的人留下来，比不断补招操作员划算得多。

ai_s7_trends: 仓储自动化渗透率持续提高，纯操作岗位继续收缩。
WMS 与数据分析能力成为仓管晋升的硬门槛。
电商与即时零售让多品类小批量仓配需求快速增长。
